steps.label: Adverse Order
steps.caption: Assessing officer transmits adverse order and statutory demand notice.

steps.label: Form Thirty Five
steps.caption: Corporate appellant drafts electronic appeal memo with statement of facts.

steps.label: Portal Upload
steps.caption: Appellant submits electronic appeal within thirty days of service.

steps.label: Registry Intake
steps.caption: National Faceless Appeal Centre acknowledges electronic lodgment.

steps.label: Admitted Tax Check
steps.caption: Appellant verifies full payment of admitted tax due on returned income.

steps.label: Stay Application
steps.caption: Appellant petitions appellate authority for stay of disputed balance.

steps.label: Discretionary Waiver
steps.caption: Appellate authority examines substantial hardship for partial deposit.

steps.label: Interim Injunction
steps.caption: Authority grants protection against coercive bank attachment recovery.

steps.label: Record Review
steps.caption: Appellate authority examines assessment records and grounds of appeal.

steps.label: Confirmation or Relief
steps.caption: Authority decides to confirm or delete disputed assessment additions.

steps.label: Enhancement Notice
steps.caption: Authority issues mandatory show cause notice prior to enhancement.

steps.label: Final Annulment
steps.caption: Authority strikes down void assessment without remanding to officer.

steps.label: Automated Assignment
steps.caption: System dynamically routes appeal to faceless appellate unit.

steps.label: Written Submissions
steps.caption: Appellant submits detailed legal rebuttal and statutory authorities.

steps.label: Virtual Hearing
steps.caption: Appellant presents oral arguments through secure video conference.

steps.label: Draft Order Review
steps.caption: Review unit approves draft before digital signing and portal delivery.

steps.label: Deadline Tracking
steps.caption: System monitors limitation period for electronic appeal lodgment.

steps.label: Hardship Assessment
steps.caption: Engine models corporate balance sheet ratios for deposit waiver.

steps.label: Evidence Categorization
steps.caption: Platform indexes supporting contracts and technical affidavits.

steps.label: Executive Dashboard
steps.caption: Appellate portfolio dashboard visualizes enterprise dispute status.
